question.prompt: The diagonals \(AC\) and \(BD\) of rectangle \(ABCD\) intersect at \(O\). Given \(\angle AOB=60^\circ\) and \(AC=8\), find the length of \(AB\).

solutions.explanation: The diagonals are equal in length and bisect each other, so \(OA=OB=4\). Since \(\angle AOB=60^\circ\), \(\triangle AOB\) is equilateral, and \(AB=4\).
solutions.title: Recognize an equilateral triangle
